scope: One reconstructed v8 shortest path per frozen frontier probe. All 48 point/cell costs match the frozen plan and path components sum to each point cost. Road chord distance connects model state positions and is not source-polyline distance; road time also includes source-arc/connector costs. Local/transfer components and endpoint attachments are separated; reference geometry is a different route, not a timing ground truth. Diagnostic search extends to750min only to include outside720 probes. No runtime/model/weight changes or provider calls.
